# DuupFlow

> DuupFlow turns one image or video into many unique copies (identical to the eye, unique to platforms) so creators and agencies can repost content across multiple accounts. It also edits videos from raw footage with Claude (AI Editor), finds an account's best videos (Scraper), compresses files, generates image variations and can remove AI-provenance metadata. Built for creators and multi-creator agencies. Web app: https://www.duupflow.com

## Help center (one page per feature)

Each page explains what the feature does, how to use it step by step, its limits/formats and which plans include it. English at the root (/docs/...), French under /fr (/fr/docs/...).

- [Help center index](https://www.duupflow.com/docs)
- [Video duplication](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/video-duplication): Simple (packs, Light/Balanced/Strong) and Advanced modes; MP4/MOV/MKV/AVI/WEBM, max 120 s and 5 GB per video, 40 videos per batch; quota = videos × copies.
- [Image duplication](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/image-duplication): JPG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC, 50 images per batch.
- [AI Editor](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/ai-editor): edit from raw footage with your own Claude via an MCP connector (works on Claude's free plan); reference + material (300 MB, video 2 min, audio 4 min); each variant = 1 video of quota.
- [Instagram & TikTok scraper](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/scraper): ranks an account's videos by performance; paid in tokens (refunded if the scan fails).
- [Comparator](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/comparator): similarity score (60% image, 40% technical); below 45% = distinct files.
- [Compressor](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/compressor): up to 30 files / 10 GB per batch, Light/Balanced/Strong, never heavier than the original.
- [AI Variation](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/ai-variation): 1–3 new images from one photo (same face, setting, lighting); 90 tokens/image on Solo, 70 on Pro/Agency.
- [Remove AI detection](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/remove-ai-detection): an option in video/image duplication and the API.
- [Creator workspaces & team roles](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/creators-and-roles): Pro 2 workspaces / 3 members, Agency 15 / 10; roles Owner, Manager, VA (VA only sees assigned creators).
- [Google Drive](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/google-drive): import with the picker, export to any folder or to the creator's "Creator — DuupFlow" folder.

## Plans (monthly price · yearly price per month)

- Solo €39 · €28: 300 video and 400 image duplications per month, AI Editor.
- Pro €99 · €70: unlimited duplications, 3 members, 2 creator workspaces, VA roles, API.
- Agency €249 · €176: everything in Pro, 10 members, 15 creator workspaces, onboarding call.
- Generated files are temporary (about one hour): download them or send them to Google Drive.

## API documentation

- [API documentation (English)](https://www.duupflow.com/docs/api): authentication, endpoints, parameters, limits, errors, examples, FAQ.
- [Documentation API (français)](https://www.duupflow.com/fr/docs/api)

## Key facts about the API

- REST API at https://www.duupflow.com/api/v1, header `Authorization: Bearer dflw_live_…`. Keys are created in the dashboard under Developers (max 3 per account, shown once).
- Included at no extra cost in the Pro and Agency plans (not Solo or Free). Unlimited duplications through the API. No free API trial; monthly Pro has no commitment. Prices: https://www.duupflow.com/pricing
- Endpoints: GET /me · POST /images/duplicate (sync, 1–20 copies, ≤ 25 MB) · POST /videos/duplicate (async job, 1–10 copies, ≤ 150 MB, ≤ 120 s; mp4/mov/mkv/avi/webm; vertical 9:16 supported) · GET /jobs/:id · GET /jobs/:id/files/:name · POST /compress (images) · POST /ai-detection (image: sync; video: async job, single output, no duplication effect).
- Video results are downloadable for 16 hours. Poll GET /jobs/:id every 5–10 s. A completion webhook is in development.
- Limits: 300 requests/min per key, 100 pending video jobs per account.
- Errors: JSON `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` (401 missing_key/invalid_key, 403 plan_required, 413 file_too_large, 415 unsupported_type, 429 rate_limited/too_many_jobs).
- AI-detection removal erases provenance metadata and invisibly retouches pixels; it cannot guarantee content will never be detected (robust watermarks such as SynthID survive).
